title: Suriya Becomes First Tamil Actor With Three 200 Crore Grossers in One Year
excerpt: Koimoi reported Karuppu, Vishwanath And Sons and Scene all crossed Rs 200 crore worldwide in 2026, with producer and tracker figures differing on Scene's exact total.
body:
• Suriya has become the first Tamil actor with three films crossing Rs 200 crore worldwide in a single year, according to Koimoi, after Scene joined Karuppu and Vishwanath And Sons in 2026.
  • Koimoi reported Karuppu at Rs 315 crore worldwide, Vishwanath And Sons at Rs 212.34 crore and Scene at Rs 202.36 crore in seven days.
  • Filmfare and Cinema Express reported that producer Zhagaram Studios announced Scene had crossed Rs 200 crore, while trade tracker Sacnilk estimated Rs 188.50 crore worldwide after six days.
  • All three films are Tamil-language releases; Scene, directed by Jithu Madhavan, is still in theatres after its Diwali release.

Suriya has set a Tamil cinema box office record in 2026, becoming the first Tamil actor to deliver three films that crossed Rs 200 crore worldwide in a single year, Koimoi reported. The milestone was completed when his Diwali release Scene crossed the mark in its opening week, joining Karuppu and Vishwanath And Sons.

Koimoi described Suriya as reportedly the third actor overall to achieve the feat, behind Akshay Kumar and Shah Rukh Khan. Filmfare and Cinema Express reported the same first-for-Tamil-cinema distinction, attributing the Scene announcement to Zhagaram Studios, the production banner associated with Suriya and his wife Jyotika.

The three films, by the reported numbers

Koimoi put the three films at the following worldwide grosses: Karuppu at Rs 315 crore worldwide with Rs 198.18 crore India net, Vishwanath And Sons at Rs 212.34 crore worldwide with Rs 122.54 crore India net, and Scene at Rs 202.36 crore worldwide with Rs 111.15 crore India net in seven days. Those are reported figures, and the sources differ on the precise total for Scene.

Filmfare reported that the producer figure placed Scene above Rs 200 crore, while Sacnilk estimated Rs 188.50 crore worldwide by the end of the sixth day, including Rs 105.45 crore India net and Rs 66 crore overseas. Cinema Express reported the same Sacnilk estimate. Readers should treat the record as based on the producer-announced crossing, with the independent tracker estimate lower at the six-day point.

What the films are

All three are Tamil-language films. Karuppu was directed by RJ Balaji, according to Koimoi. Scene was directed by Jithu Madhavan and follows a police officer played by Suriya who investigates a murder resembling a 'Perfume Killer' case he had previously solved, according to Filmfare and Cinema Express.

Filmfare reported that Nazriya Nazim plays Maya, an ally to Suriya's character, and Naslen plays Eeshwaran, the antagonist. The film marks Nazriya Nazim's return to Tamil cinema after 12 years and Naslen's Tamil debut, and it is composer Sushin Shyam's first Tamil project, according to both Filmfare and Cinema Express.

Can Scene reach Rs 300 crore?

Koimoi reported that Scene was tracking toward Rs 300 crore if it held its pace into the second weekend, which would give Suriya a second Rs 300 crore grosser of 2026 after Karuppu. Filmfare reported a different near-term picture: Sacnilk data showed Scene collecting Rs 8.05 crore net in India on its sixth day, down from Rs 12.85 crore the day before, with new releases arriving from November 13 and November 20.

For diaspora readers, Scene remains a theatrical release at the time of these reports. The sources read for this article did not announce a streaming date, so viewers outside India should check local Tamil film listings for current showtimes rather than assume an OTT date.

Read the original reporting in Koimoi and Cinema Express.
